newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Santos says Brisbane gas flow starts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Santos says Brisbane gas flow starts.

text.p: Natural gas has begun flowing from the South West Queensland Unit of the onshore Cooper/Eromanga Basin to Brisbane through a recently completed pipeline, operator Santos Ltd said on Thursday.
"Sales have commenced already to commission and pack the pipeline with the first gas expected to be provided to Brisbane customers from 1 January 1997", Santos managing director Ross Adler said.
"Full scale deliveries will commence from 1 July 1997 following the full upgrading of the Ballera Gas Plant," he said in a statement.
"This provides major advantages to South East Queensland through a secure long-term supply of gas at world competitive prices," Adler said.
The contracts, which were signed in September 1995, are valued at more than A$1 billion, Santos said.
They involved significant expenditure on upgrading the Ballera Gas Plant and on exploration and field development, Santos said.

The South West Queensland Unit Producers are Santos Group 58.8625 percent, Exxon Corp unit Delhi Petroleum Pty Ltd 23.2 percent, Boral Ltd unit Boral Energy Resources Ltd 16.5 percent, Australian Hydrocarbons Ltd 1.2 percent and Oil Co of Australia Ltd 0.2375 percent.
